p: reigneth: As God by his power and wisdom has made and governed the world, so must the same be our defence against all enemies and dangers.
throne is established of old: In which you sit and govern the world.
The floods have lifted up: God's power appears in ruling the furious waters.
testimonies are very sure: Besides God's power and wisdom in creating and governing his great mercy also appears in that he has given his people his word and covenant.
